info.title: media_gen_api
info.description:
Media Generation API.

Reference inputs accept inline data URIs or files uploaded through
`https://storage.fast-gen.ai`. V6 requests use the returned storage ID directly;
legacy V5 requests prefix it with `file:`. Generated results expose a download
URL, inline data, or text according to the operation.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint backed by stored web accounts.

Use OpenRouter-style model ids such as `openai/gpt-4o`, `x-ai/grok-4`, or `google/gemini-3.6-flash`. Unprefixed aliases remain accepted. `models` and `provider` are accepted in the OpenRouter style for provider-aware routing.

OpenAI, Grok, and Gemini web responses use the `prompt.tokens.hour` quota.

Gemini models accept image parts only for licenses with the `chat.multimodal` capability. Generated media remains disabled.

Streaming responses use `text/event-stream`.

200.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion. If `stream=true`, the same endpoint returns server-sent events.

Promotional multipliers already applied to the reported limits.

Forwarded verbatim from the license server. A null entry means no active
promo for that kind. Clients must gate on `until` rather than on the mere
presence of the object: license data is cached here, so a window can close
before the cached payload expires.

OperationCancelResult.title: OperationCancelResult
OperationCancelResult.description:
Result for a single operation cancellation within a bulk request.

Refund Policy:
    - If cancelled while "pending": refunded=True (generation hadn't started)
    - If cancelled while "processing": refunded=False (resources already consumed)
    - If already completed: cancelled=False, refunded=False
